import socket
import threading
import random

def create_connection(host, port):
    sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    sock.settimeout(1)
    sock.bind((host, port))
    sock.connect((host, port))
    return sock

def create_node(host, port):
    node = threading.Thread(target=create_connection)
    node.daemon = True
    node.start()
    return node


def create_connection(host, port):
    sock = create_connection(host, port)
    sock.bind((host, port))
    sock.connect((host, port))
    return sock

def create_node(host, port):
    node = create_connection(host, port)
    node.start()
    return node


def main():
    host = "localhost"
    port = 12345
    node1 = create_node("localhost", 12345)
